mechanism_of_action: Allosteric biased GLP-1R agonist (G-protein biased / reduced beta-arrestin)
design_rationale: Engineered with a trifluoro-dimethoxy aromatic anchor to form tight pi-stacking against Trp33, coupled to an azaindole bicyclic core that establishes a directional hydrogen bond with Arg380, and a 4-fluorophenyl group that projects into the deep hydrophobic pocket of TM5/TM6. Selective Gs activation over beta-arrestin significantly mitigates GI adverse effects (nausea/vomiting).

properties.predicted_oral_bioavailability: High (>70%) based on Veber & Lipinski compliance
properties.predicted_half_life: ~28 - 34 hours (suitable for true Once-Daily or Once-Weekly oral dosing)
